name: smwmusic-baba-is-you-cog-is-push-chrono-trigger-style
title: Baba Is You - Cog Is Push (Chrono Trigger style)
description:
A song from the acclaimed puzzle game Baba Is You, fashioned to sound like Chrono Trigger's "Secret of the Forest". Apologies to anyone who would've liked a 1:1 port of this song.

Shoutouts to RednGreen for his Secret of the Forest port which I used as a base.
